concept.title: Understand CIS guidance in BPM
concept.shortdesc: BPM documents its own Firefox hardening mappings for the CIS Mozilla Firefox ESR GPO Benchmark without copying restricted benchmark prose or claiming certification.

section.title: Benchmark used by BPM
section.p: BPM identifies mappings against the CIS Mozilla Firefox ESR GPO Benchmark version 1.0.0, released on 2024-07-19 and tested by CIS against Mozilla Firefox 115.10 ESR on Windows 11 Release 23H2. BPM also validates exported policy shape against its bundled Firefox ESR 140.13 and Firefox Release 153 schemas, so the BPM channel you choose still matters.

section.title: What BPM publishes
section.p: The guide publishes BPM-authored descriptions of recommendation IDs, levels, generated layers, policy or managed-preference targets, merge behavior, manual-review states, and verification handoffs. BPM maps 55 recommendation records and keeps two unresolved records as provenance-only entries.

section.title: What BPM does not prove
section.p: BPM is an independent implementation and is not authorized, sponsored, endorsed, certified, or approved by CIS. The guide is not a substitute for the official CIS benchmark, and a BPM export does not prove CIS compliance or Firefox runtime behavior in every environment.

section.title: When to use CIS guidance
section.p: Use CIS guidance when a profile needs a documented security baseline for enterprise review, kiosk preparation, protected workstations, or a comparison between a starter preset and a hardened layer. Do not use it as the only deployment approval: review local update, proxy, certificate, extension, privacy, and evidence-retention requirements before export.
